sentences.text: Raju Karmkar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 11 July, 2024

Author: Ananda Sen
Bench: Ananda Sen, Gautam Kumar Choudhary

In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 Crl. Appeal (Db) No. 2127 of 2023
 Raju Karmkar ..... Appellant
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand ... Respondent
 ..............
 Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J.
Sri Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.
For the Appellant(s) : Mrs. Rashmi Kumar, Advocate.

For the Resp.-State : Ms. Amrita Kumari, App
-----
Order No.04, Dated 11th July, 2024.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has been convicted under Sections 304(B) & 498A IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years.

He submits that he being husband is in custody since 14.11.2015 (i.e. almost 9 years).
This case has already been admitted and the LCR has already been received.
This Court deems it fit for hearing.
Accordingly, list this case on 16.07.2024 under the heading for "Final Hearing".
Accordingly, the instant I.A. is dismissed.
